name: OpenAI
intro: OpenAI turned ChatGPT into the fastest-scaling consumer subscription in history and layered a usage-based API business on top — from ~$6B annualized in 2024 to a ~$25B run rate by February 2026. Every reported ARR, funding and valuation number is collected below, each traced back to a public source.

modelTitle: How $20 ChatGPT Plans Fund a $13B Year.
modelParagraphs: OpenAI monetizes consumer subscriptions first — ChatGPT Plus at $20/month and Pro at $200/month, plus Team and Enterprise seats — with the usage-based API (per-token pricing across GPT model tiers) as the second engine. ChatGPT became the fastest-scaling consumer subscription ever, and weekly-active users in the hundreds of millions convert at the $20 tier at meaningful rates.

The cost structure is the caveat: booked 2025 revenue was ~$13.07B against a ~$20.9B operating loss, so the run-rate headline and the P&L diverge sharply. Enterprise contracts and API usage carry much higher gross margins than inference-heavy consumer plans, and the mix shifts steadily toward enterprise.

faqs.a: OpenAI's annualized run rate reached roughly $25 billion by February 2026, up from ~$8 billion in March 2025 and ~$6 billion in 2024. CFO Sarah Friar confirmed the company crossed $20B annualized at the end of 2025. Some mid-2026 trackers put the run rate near $40B; the conservative reported figure is used here.

faqs.q: How Fast Did OpenAI Reach $100M ARR?
faqs.a: About 36 months. OpenAI's API-era revenue grew slowly before ChatGPT, and the $100M milestone came in the run-up to the November 2022 launch — slow by AI-startup standards, before the steepest consumer ramp in history followed.

No. Booked 2025 revenue was ~$13.07 billion against an operating loss of roughly $20.9 billion — the loss exceeded the revenue. Inference costs, especially on consumer subscriptions, remain the core margin problem.

faqs.q: What Is OpenAI's Valuation and How Much Has It Raised?
faqs.a: $852 billion as of its May 2026 round, following the Microsoft restructuring. OpenAI is the most valuable private AI company and has raised tens of billions across rounds, including corporate and debt-financed compute commitments.

Consumer subscriptions ($20/month Plus, $200/month Pro), usage-based API billing per token, and custom ChatGPT Enterprise contracts. Subscriptions dominate volume; API and enterprise deals dominate margin.
